notes.title: Day 1 Hotfix Update (Important, Read!)
notes.content:
We’ve released a Day 1 update for The Duchess Curse! This patch resolves several bugs and includes a critical fix to the save/load system for smoother gameplay.

⚠️ Important:

    It is crucial to install the UEPrereqSetup.exe file located in the Extras folder within the game directory. This installation ensures all necessary components are set up for the game to function properly.
    Avoid loading save files created before this update, as they may cause issues or break the game. Starting a new game is strongly recommended.

Thank you for your patience and support as we refine your experience!

notes.title: Demo Update: Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
We've fixed a bug that allowed players to access areas intended only for the full game and made additional improvements. We apologize for the larger update size—due to a critical error, we had to rebuild parts of the game to ensure a smoother experience.

Thank you for your patience, and enjoy the demo!

notes.title: Demo Update: Stability Improvements
notes.content:
We've received reports of occasional crashes during gameplay in the demo. Our team has implemented several fixes and adjustments to improve stability. However, please note that crashes may still occur if you play on extreme settings or very high resolutions. We're actively working on a permanent solution for this.

In the meantime, lowering your graphics settings slightly should help ensure a smoother experience. We hope you enjoy the demo, and thank you for your understanding and support!
